messages.author: Sushil Mishra
messages.body:
I recently bought a few workstations with RTX3080 and RTX3090  GPUs and am
very happy with the cost/performance ratio. If you are in the US, advanced
HPC gave us very competitive quotes.
Best,
Sushil
